name: ORCA Lease Registry
description: ORCA's cross-session file-lease registry: independent agents (Claude Code sessions, Jarvis, ORCA runs) serialize per-file with fast handoff on ONE working tree — no branches, no merges. Exposes orca.lease.* RPCs over atomic on-disk leases + a stale-lease GC janitor.

leaseTtlMs.description: Default lease time-to-live in ms when a caller omits one. After this, a held lease is reclaimable. Default 300000 (5 min).

janitorCadenceMs.description: How often the background janitor sweeps stale leases. Default 60000 (60s).

leaseTtlMs.label: Lease TTL (ms)
leaseTtlMs.help: Default per-file lease lifetime before it can be stolen.
